  • ​77.6% Potential NOI Growth: Net operating income is projected to grow from $725,275 trailing to $1,288,164 by Year Two through the implementation of the cap-ex program, pushing rents and recapturing utilities
  • ​Golf Course Frontage: The western property line abuts the Rockledge Country Club course, giving a material share of units a permanent, protected open-space view no competitor can replicate
  • ​Household Income: Average household income within five miles is $98,262, and the asset fronts South Fiske Boulevard at 27,500 vehicles per day
  • ​Major Employers: Located Twenty-five minutes for SpaceX, Blue Origin, Airbus OneWeb, Boeing and Lockheed Martin
  • ​Location: Brevard County exceeds 616,000 residents and ranks #21 nationally for job growth and #24 for fastest-growing tech sector (Milken Institute, 2025)
  • ​Development Pipeline: Space Coast Innovation Park is delivering 3 million square feet of Class-A industrial, Eastern Florida State College’s nearby Cocoa campus is midway through an $87 million expansion and Dassault opened a 175,000 SF jet maintenance facility in October 2025
  • ​Limited Direct Competition: There are few comparable properties in the submarket that offer the unit size and amenity package that Rockledge Villas offers
  • ​Construction: Eight two-story buildings of concrete block and stucco with copper supply plumbing and copper wiring
  • ​Amenity Set: Swimming pool and sundeck, playground, volleyball court, tenant storage, and screened-in patios and balconies that extend usable living space year-round
  • ​Balanced Unit Mix: Forty-one one-bedrooms (43%), forty-eight two-bedrooms (51%), and six three-bedrooms (6%) average 922 square feet — large for the vintage
